claim.en: Sigstore is an open source project for signing and verifying artifacts with signing events recorded in a public log; Fulcio issues short-lived certificates, Rekor is a transparency log and keyless signing discards the key pair after signing.

entries.validation: page opened; section 2.1 hash definitions; the RFC is obsoleted by RFC 9162

claim.es: El RFC 6962 define el hash de árbol de Merkle con hoja SHA-256(0x00 || dato) y nodo SHA-256(0x01 || izquierda || derecha), partiendo en la mayor potencia de dos menor que n, con pruebas de inclusión y consistencia; está obsoleto por el RFC 9162.
claim.en: RFC 6962 defines the Merkle tree hash with leaf SHA-256(0x00 || data) and node SHA-256(0x01 || left || right), splitting at the largest power of two smaller than n, with inclusion and consistency proofs; it is obsoleted by RFC 9162.

claim.en: The Go blog describes the checksum database as built on a transparent log (Merkle tree) of hashes backed by Trillian, with inclusion and consistency checks by the go command.

entries.source: Amazon S3 User Guide, Object Lock: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html
entries.validation: page opened and read

claim.es: S3 Object Lock usa un modelo escribir-una-vez-leer-muchas, solo funciona en buckets con versionado, y tiene modo gobernanza (se puede saltar con el permiso s3:BypassGovernanceRetention) y modo compliance (ningún usuario, ni el root, puede borrar durante la retención).
claim.en: S3 Object Lock uses a write-once-read-many model, works only on versioned buckets, and has governance mode (can be bypassed with the s3:BypassGovernanceRetention permission) and compliance mode (no user, not even root, can delete during retention).

entries.validation: page opened; summary returned by the fetch tool, statements quoted as returned

claim.es: Backblaze B2 ofrece Object Lock con modo gobernanza (modificable o saltable por clientes con las capacidades de clave adecuadas) y modo compliance (nadie puede quitarlo), que debe habilitarse en el bucket y no se puede desactivar después.
claim.en: Backblaze B2 offers Object Lock with governance mode (modifiable or overridable by clients with the right key capabilities) and compliance mode (nobody can remove it), which must be enabled on the bucket and cannot be disabled afterwards.
